description: Cooperative customer completing standard qualification with CRM lead sync.

crm_action.message: Lead CRM-LEAD-2025-0001 successfully created and synced with sales queue.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Welcome to ApexCare Global Health Shield. My name is Alex. I can verify your eligibility and prepare a customized coverage quote in just two minutes. To get started, may I have your name and age?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi, I'm calling to check health insurance options for myself.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, Calling To. To verify your qualification, could you please confirm your current age?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: My name is David Miller and I am 34 years old.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Got it, David Miller. Do you or anyone you are enrolling have any ongoing pre-existing medical conditions, such as diabetes, hypertension, asthma, or recent surgeries?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No pre-existing conditions, I run 5 miles every week and am in great health.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great news! Based on your profile, you are pre-qualified for the ApexCare Standard Shield with an Annual Maximum Benefit of $1,000,000. Your estimated rate starts at $209.97 per month with a $1,000 annual deductible. I have created lead record #CRM-LEAD-2025-0001 and dispatched the complete schedule of benefits to your email. Is there anything else I can clarify for you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That sounds reasonable. No further questions, thank you!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Wonderful! Thank you for calling ApexCare Global Health. Have a healthy and pleasant day ahead!
